data.long_meaning: The meaning of Sam is recorded in name-lists as “God has heard”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sam expresses “God has heard”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sam total 6, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: שַׁם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם (Shem) - שם (name) - שַׁם (Sham) - Hebrew word for 'name' and 'fame' - biblical reference to sons of Noah (Genesis 5:32) - signifies reputation, identity, and honor - used in various contexts in Jewish and Christian traditions - spiritual significance of knowing one's purpose and living up to one's name

in_greek.name: Σάμ
in_greek.long_meaning: Σάμ (Sam) - Σάμ (famous, renowned) - Greek word 'Σάμ' (Sam) - related to Hebrew word 'שַׁם' (Shem) - biblical reference to Jesus Christ (John 1:42) - historical usage in early Christian church as a nickname for Simon Peter - spiritual significance of being known and recognized for one's faith

in_latin.name: Sam
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Sam - cognomen - famous, renowned - Latin word for 'name' and 'fame' - related to Greek word 'Σάμ' (Sam) - historical usage in early Christian church as a short form of names like Samuel or Sampson - spiritual significance of living up to one's name and reputation
